test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A thief running at a speed of 7 km/h is chased by a policeman, whose speed is 8 km/h. If the thief is 85 m ahead of the policeman, how much time will it take for the policeman to catch the thief?
solution:
Given:

A policeman notices a thief from a distance = 85 m.

A policeman runs at the rate of 8 km/hr

And thief run at the rate of 7 km/hr

Formula used:

Distance = speed x time

Calculation:

Relative speed = (8 - 7)km/hr = 1 km/hr

Time = 85/(1 × 5/18)

⇒ 17 × 18 sec = 306 seconds

= 306/60 = 5.1 minutes

∴ The answer is 5.1 minutes.
